fusions.name: Long Way Round
fusions.desc: Looses a quill that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%). Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Wingbeat Scatter
fusions.desc: A sudden wingbeat deals 12 wind damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you and knocks it back 3 tiles. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Talon Lift
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you are lifted 4 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Stoop From Cover
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your critical chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
